primary.label: Primary — 60%+ under the 52-week high
primary.definition: a body under 5% of the range, the low within 5% either side of the prior 20-session low (set 4+ sessions before), the $10M/day floor, 60%+ under the 52-week high (his "60% 70%"); next open, 10 sessions, net of SPY

primary.label: Primary — 60%+ under the 52-week high
primary.definition: a body under 5% of the range, the low within 5% either side of the prior 20-session low (set 4+ sessions before), the $10M/day floor, 60%+ under the 52-week high (his "60% 70%"); next open, 10 sessions, net of SPY

any_read.label: Any downtrend read (the tab's default view)
any_read.definition: a body under 5% of the range, the low within 5% either side of the prior 20-session low (set 4+ sessions before), the $10M/day floor, any of 60%+ under the 52-week high, 60%+ under the all-time high, or below the 50- and 200-day

test_no_doji.label: The control — a test of the low without a doji
test_no_doji.definition: a body of 10% of the range or more, the same test, floor and 52-week read as the primary, against its own matched days

mas_only.label: Below the averages only
mas_only.definition: any_read whose ONLY read is the averages

doji10.label: Body under 10%
doji10.definition: the any_read rule at a body under 10% of the range

above.label: Low at or above the prior low
above.definition: any_read and the low at or above the prior low (0 … +5%)

undercut.label: Undercut the prior low
undercut.definition: any_read and the low under the prior low (−5% … 0)

undercut_reclaimed.label: Undercut and reclaimed
undercut_reclaimed.definition: any_read, the low under the prior low and the close back above it

undercut_closed_under.label: Undercut, closed under
undercut_closed_under.definition: any_read, the low under the prior low and the close not above it

undercut_deep.label: Undercut by more than 5% (outside his test)
undercut_deep.definition: a doji (5%), the prior low 4+ sessions old, the low more than 5% under it, any read, the floor

swing_sweep.label: The smc swing-low sweep (Q4)
swing_sweep.definition: a doji (5%), any read, the floor, and a sell-side sweep of a swing low (window 3, lookback 60) on the candle

vol_quiet.label: Quiet volume
vol_quiet.definition: any_read and volume at or under 1× the 50-day average

vol_heavy.label: Heavy volume
vol_heavy.definition: any_read and volume at 1.5× the 50-day average or more

doji_no_test.label: A doji, no test
doji_no_test.definition: a doji (5%), the prior low 4+ sessions old, the low more than 5% above it, any read, the floor

independent.label: One per name per 10 sessions
independent.definition: any_read, greedy in date order: an event within 10 sessions after a kept one of the same name is dropped

all_liquidity.label: No liquidity floor
all_liquidity.definition: the any_read rule without the floor (placebos without it too)

from_close.label: Entry at the doji close
from_close.definition: any_read; the return from the doji's own close

confirm_entry.label: Entry at the confirming close
confirm_entry.definition: any_read events that closed above the doji's high within 5 sessions; the return from that close (placebos conditioned the same way)

test_no_doji_fire_pool.label: The control against the primary's pool (a sensitivity)
test_no_doji_fire_pool.definition: the test_no_doji events, their matched days drawn from the primary's pool rule (the fire-based exclusions only, without the control's own-event exclusion) — numbers only, never compared with the primary as a verdict

limits: survivors-only: the universe is today's list — deep-drawdown names that delisted are absent; absolute returns are biased up, and the same-name matched days only partly cancel it
the two-year price cache gives about one year of evaluable sessions (a 252-session window first) — one market regime
adjacent events' outcome windows overlap; the session-block and the by-name resampling keep them together, they do not remove the overlap

the all-time high before the stored high's month is the frame's running max — a lower bound, so a name may be missed, never falsely included; the misses are not random — a name that later set a new all-time high (the later big runners) gets only the frame read, so it is under-included in the ath and any_read cells
next-open entries assume the open print; close-to-close daily bars, no intraday fill is modelled
the sizing probe says about 90% of his tests never undercut the prior low — the undercut cells are thin
